items.title: Coinbase Global (COIN) Will Attend A White House Crypto Summit
items.summary: Coinbase Global (NasdaqGS:COIN) executives are set to join U.S. regulators and Ripple leaders at a White House crypto summit, highlighting direct policy engagement at the federal level. The summit will include participation from key agencies such as the SEC and CFTC, with crypto regulation and industry input expected to be central topics.
